title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Graph Systems
description: Back to jobs New Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Graph Systems United States Apply About Us: Inca Digital is a veteran-owned data and intelligence company specializing in digital-asset analytics for exchanges, financial institutions, regulators, and blockchain ecosystems. Our technology and expertise provide clarity across crypto markets, tracking blockchain transactions, liquidity movements, and illicit finance, helping clients identify risk, enhance transparency, and improve decision-making. Inca’s infrastructure fuses structured and unstructured data from blockchains, exchanges, social networks, and financial markets. The result is a powerful analytics engine that supports ecosystem monitoring, market surveillance, and counter–illicit finance intelligence across digital-asset networks. Inca operates as a fast-paced, nimble, global, and remote technology company. We leverage an asynchronous‑first workflow, try to minimize time spent on meetings, and believe in open debate and logic over authority. Work alongside some of the sharpest minds in the world, including intelligence analysts, defense veterans, data engineers, quant researchers, linguists, and more. Role Overview: As a Software Engineer on our Research & Development Team, you will help design, build, and scale new data products, infrastructure, and investigative tools from the ground up. Reporting directly to the Head of R&D, you will play a central role in system integration, feature design, and product prioritization while taking direct ownership of core engineering initiatives. The R&D team is the engine behind Inca’s intelligence platform. We consume, process, store, and analyze massive streams of internal and external data, transforming complex, interconnected datasets into actionable, production-grade APIs, graph analytics, interactive dashboards, and real-time alert systems used directly by our clients. What You'll Own Design, build, and operate end-to-end data infrastructure and solutions for delivering APIs, custom containerized applications, automated alerting/reporting, and graph-based visualizations to federal and commercial clients. Model and deploy relational, document, and graph databases for supporting investigative workflows and large-scale network analysis. Build resilient ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, normalize, and reconcile structured and semi-structured data from internal databases, REST APIs, blockchain nodes, and third-party feeds. Own data quality, lineage, and reproducibility. Our outputs support enforcement actions and litigation, so provenance is a product requirement, not a nice-to-have. Automate orchestration, systems integration, and deployment through CI/CD (GitHub Actions) into AWS cloud environments. Partner with the Head of R&D, data scientists, and our specialized investigations teams to translate intelligence requirements into production software. Make and document architecture decisions, evaluate new technology, and cut through genuinely ambiguous problems spanning crypto, finance, and national security. What We Require You must be able to pass a U.S. Tier 3 background investigation, which under federal rules is generally limited to U.S. citizens. Proficient in Python. Proven experience designing and operating production data infrastructure and pipelines — systems you were responsible for when they broke, not only contributed to. Deep PostgreSQL experience (self-managed or RDS/Aurora), including schema design and query optimization. Graph data modeling and network analysis experience. Neo4j and Cypher preferred; Neptune or a comparable graph database is fine. Comprehensive grasp of architectural trade-offs when deploying graph-based systems, including specific performance advantages and technical limitations. Production experience deploying and configuring containerized services to AWS. Nice to Have Infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform). Go as an additional language. An active TS/SCI. We sponsor investigations for candidates without one, and you can begin work before adjudication completes. Message queues and event-driven data pipelines (SQS/SNS, Kafka), and search or document stores (OpenSearch, MongoDB). Familiarity with blockchain ledger data, smart contracts, or blockchain analytics. You will ramp meaningfully faster with it, and we weigh this heavily. NLP techniques, LLM integration, or building and evaluating ML models. Background in financial services or trading venues, or familiarity with SEC, CFTC, or FinCEN regulatory frameworks. Experience operating in FedRAMP, AWS GovCloud, or NIST 800-171 environments. Why join us? We operate in a fully remote, high-trust environment and prioritize impact and delivered results over hours logged. We offer competitive compensation and healthcare stipend. We invest in our people through childcare stipends and dedicated employee assistance resources. Join a thought leader at the intersection of national security and digital assets, working with cutting-edge tech that defines the field. Curious about how we build at Inca Digital? Hear directly from our Head of R&D on how our team builds the infrastructure that powers Inca's intelligence, merging financial, natural language, and blockchain data into custom dashboards and automation tools built around each client's needs. 🎥 Watch on YouTube: Inside Inca | The Engine Behind Inca's Intelligence Inclusion & Equal Opportunity: As a veteran-owned company, Inca Digital thrives on diverse perspectives, specifically across race, gender, neurodivergence, and veteran status, to solve complex data challenges. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to protected status, including disability or national origin. title: Senior Software Engineer, Identity & Access Discovery
description: Back to jobs New Senior Software Engineer, Identity & Access Discovery Remote, US Apply Description Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Privileged Access Management team and lead backend development for Discovery capabilities within KeeperPAM. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas. Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help build the systems that discover and secure privileged identities and infrastructure across complex enterprise environments. About Keeper Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com. About the Job As a Senior Software Engineer on Keeper's PAM Discovery team, you will be a primary developer for the backend discovery service that identifies privileged accounts, service accounts, keys and machines across Active Directory, cloud IAM, databases and endpoints so they can be brought under secure management and rotation. This is primarily a backend engineering role, most of your time will be spent building services, data pipelines and integrations in Python, with some Java/Kotlin work on our cloud services and occasional changes to our TypeScript/React administrative interface. What makes this problem interesting: Discovery runs on gateways deployed inside customer environments that Keeper cannot access directly, so the system has to be resilient, self-diagnosing and safe even when debugging access is limited and deployed versions vary. And Keeper's zero-knowledge architecture requires discovered data to be encrypted before it leaves the customer environment, which rules out most of the conventional answers for how that data can be processed, indexed and presented. Responsibilities Design and develop the Python discovery engine that runs on customer-deployed gateways, and the Java/Kotlin cloud services that store and serve discovered data Build systems that discover privileged accounts, service accounts, keys, machines and related identity data across Active Directory, cloud IAM, databases and endpoints Solve identity correlation and reconciliation challenges, including determining when accounts discovered across multiple systems represent the same principal Build incremental re-scan and state-reconciliation capabilities that maintain an accurate view of customer environments without accumulating duplicate or stale data Build the test coverage and diagnostic tooling that let us trust code we can't debug in the field: unit, integration and automated tests, plus logging and error reporting good enough to root-cause an issue from a customer's logs alone Design discovery workflows that operate safely inside customer production networks, respecting API limits, limiting blast radius and remaining resilient to partial failures across large environments Develop secure data-processing workflows that operate within Keeper’s zero-knowledge architecture and protect discovered data throughout collection, transmission and storage Collaborate with Product, QA and other PAM engineers on technical design, testing, troubleshooting and delivery of Discovery features Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to support development, debugging, research and documentation Requirements 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on backend systems Strong Python experience with Python is the primary language of Keeper's Discovery engine Working proficiency in Java or Kotlin for backend services, plus enough comfort in TypeScript/React to make changes in our administrative interface when needed Strong experience with distributed systems, APIs and data-processing pipelines, including systems that must run reliably in environments you don't control Hands-on experience with Active Directory and/or LDAP Working knowledge of at least one major cloud IAM model, such as AWS IAM and Organizations, Microsoft Entra ID or GCP IAM Strong knowledge of secure software development practices, authentication, authorization and encryption Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong data modeling instincts, ideally including graph or relationship-oriented models Due to this role's involvement in GovCloud and FedRAMP environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident Preferred Qualifications Experience developing Privileged Access Management, identity security or cybersecurity products Experience with identity discovery, account discovery, asset inventory or similar infrastructure discovery systems Experience with containerized or cloud-native applications Experience developing high-scale enterprise SaaS products Benefits Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships) Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental Life Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance 401K (Roth/Traditional) A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc.) Above-market annual bonuses Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. title: Principal Software Engineer
description: Back to jobs New Principal Software Engineer Columbus, Ohio; Irvine, California; or Remote within the U.S. Apply About the Company Avandra Imaging's mission is to unlock clinical data to overcome previously impossible medical challenges, bringing hope and medical breakthroughs that transform patient lives. Avandra is poised to revolutionize healthcare research and innovation by creating the largest indexed data cloud of medical imaging. This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care. Leveraging its strategic acquisitions, Avandra aims to aggregate and de-identify vast amounts of imaging data, providing frictionless access to this invaluable resource. With a national footprint of over 5,000 customer integrations and a market share of approximately 70%, this robust infrastructure supports their core business, ensuring continued growth and cash flow to fuel their innovative data cloud platform. About the Job As a Principal Software Engineer at Avandra Imaging, you’ll serve as a hands-on technical leader, collaborating across Engineering, Product, and other areas of the business to shape and deliver systems that are secure, scalable, and high-impact. You’ll be trusted to drive architectural direction, mentor other engineers, and set quality standards across the stack. This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives in complex technical domains, influences through expertise rather than authority, and elevates the work of others through mentorship, collaboration, and a commitment to engineering excellence. This role goes beyond individual contributions — you’ll model engineering excellence, influence technical strategy, and help foster a team culture built on curiosity, craftsmanship, and care. You’ll often lead without authority, earning influence through deep technical insight, sound judgment, and a reputation for raising the bar. What You’ll Do Architect and lead the development of critical systems, services, and infrastructure — with a focus on reliability, security, performance, and maintainability. Partner with product and program leaders to ensure engineering solutions align with user needs, regulatory requirements, and business outcomes. Set and evolve technical standards across the organization. Proactively address tech debt, guide code review quality, and drive initiatives that improve team velocity and code quality. Coach and mentor engineers across teams — helping them grow their craft, navigate ambiguity, and develop in their careers. Investigate and evaluate new technologies to drive innovation, simplify complexity, and support scale. Contribute directly to codebases, especially for architectural foundations, prototypes, and complex or high-risk areas. Serve as a multiplier, identifying gaps, facilitating collaboration, and unblocking teams without taking over. Uphold and strengthen our engineering culture, with a commitment to curiosity, learning, integrity, and positive team dynamics. Help recruit and onboard exceptional talent, contributing to a team that reflects our values and mission. What You’ll Need 12+ years of experience as an engineer across multiple tech stacks, with deep experience building and scaling distributed systems. Proven ability to operate as a technical leader — setting direction, influencing others, and delivering results without formal authority. Strong foundation in software engineering best practices, including CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and infrastructure as code. Experience with cloud-native systems (preferably AWS), including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) Solid knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, Demonstrated success in a highly regulated environment, preferably healthcare, with an understanding of compliance and data protection (e.g., HIPAA). Effective communicator and cross-functional collaborator, comfortable representing engineering in executive conversations and product strategy. Passion for teaching, mentoring, and cultivating a high-trust, high-autonomy team environment. What We Offer Meaningful Impact: The work we do directly enables medical breakthroughs — such as earlier cancer detection, better Alzheimer's treatments, AI diagnostics that save lives. This isn't abstract; it's the reason our health system partners invest in us. Career-Defining Opportunity: You'll have a front-row seat to every aspect of building a category-defining company—strategy, operations, fundraising, M&A, scaling. Exceptional Team: Work alongside a founder with a track record of building and exiting healthcare technology companies, backed by investors who are true partners. Competitive Package: Competitive salary, equity, comprehensive benefits, and hybrid work flexibility. title: ISV Partnerships Manager
description: Back to jobs New ISV Partnerships Manager Remote - US Apply Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals. But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an: ISV Partnerships Manager! About the Role: B2's fastest-growing adoption path in IT, M&E industries is ISV integration. When Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, or Iconik ships B2 as a validated storage endpoint, every customer they sell becomes a B2 customer without a single outbound motion. That is the flywheel. This role owns the pillar of building B2 into the default storage layer for the ISV applications that serve IT infrastructure, Media & Entertainment, and AI/Data workflows. You will own the ISV partnership program from signed integration to co-sell to joint reference architecture — and you will extend DevRel (Flamethrower) into the ISV ecosystem to create technical pull. The existing M&E integrator ecosystem (CHESA, Cinesys, Diversified, IMT, KCM) gives you an immediate warm base. These are active partners with Powered By Backblaze deployments and specific asks (cold storage tier, simplified coverage, programmatic MDF). You are inheriting a running program — your mandate is to scale it and add the next tier of ISV logos. What You’ll Do: Backup & Recovery ISV Tier Own the Veeam, Cohesity, and Rubrik partnerships end-to-end — from technical integration certification to co-sell activation to joint pipeline. Drive B2 into the validated storage endpoint documentation for each backup ISV. Every Veeam/Cohesity/Rubrik deployment should default to B2 as the cloud tier, at the same or better tier than AWS S3 or Wasabi. Work with Enablement to build ISV-specific sales plays: "B2 + Veeam immutable backup" and "B2 + Cohesity DataProtect" as repeatable deal structures as examples. Media Asset Management & M&E ISV Tier Own the Iconik, Telestream, Cantemo, and MAM/DAM/PAM platform relationships — the software layer that sits above B2 in every M&E workflow. Accelerate the Diversified / Iconik / B2 "connected stack" into a formal co-sell motion. Rich Zabel's team at Diversified is converting Wasabi customers to B2 at renewal — you operationalize that. Address the cold storage ask from Diversified and Cinesys: develop a formal storage narrative and bring it to the ISV partners who are losing deals without it. Work with CHESA to extend Powered By Backblaze into their Acorn Cloud Services offering — and solve their coverage model complaint (assign one pod per top M&E partner). Data & AI ISV Tier Own Dropbox, Databricks, Snowflake, Splunk, and Datadog integrations — B2 as the data lake / log archive tier for AI and analytics workflows. With (DevRel/Flamethrower, drive technical co-development: B2 as the S3-compatible data source for Databricks Unity Catalog, Snowflake External Tables, and Datadog Archive Storage. Identify 2–3 net-new AI-adjacent ISV integrations per quarter — specifically in the Physical AI and Surveillance verticals called out on the ecosystem roadmap. Extend DevRel into the ISV Ecosystem "Extend Dev-Rel with ISVs" is the stated goal. This means: co-authoring integration guides, producing joint technical content, and running developer-facing webinars or workshops with ISV partners. Coordinate with Dev-Rel to ensure every ISV integration produces a publishable Flamethrower-grade technical asset — SDK documentation, integration guide, or reference architecture. Measure ISV health by integration depth, not just partner count: certified integration → co-sell activation → published joint reference arch → Tier-1 analyst coverage. M&E Partner Program Operations Own the top M&E integrator relationships (CHESA, Cinesys, Diversified, IMT, KCM) and the program mechanics they need: programmatic MDF, deal registration at 25% margin, QBR cadence, and dedicated pod assignments. Resolve the coverage model complaints from CHESA and Diversified — one assigned AE/SE/CSM pod per top partner, enforced with Joey Myers (RevOps). Evaluate the next tier of M&E integrators: Mega Media, Bridge Digital, ASG — and determine add vs. hold based on revenue contribution and geographic coverage gaps. FY2026 OKR Accountability Generate partner-sourced pipeline that contributes to the $20M TCV bookings OKR — specifically through ISV integrations. Deliver 2+ public co-branded reference architectures with ISV partners by end per quarter in FY 2026 Achieve 3 public customer references from the M&E or data ISV tier per quarter starting FY 2027. The Right Fit: Required 10+ years in technology partnerships, ISV alliances, or developer ecosystem roles — cloud infrastructure, storage, backup/recovery, or data platforms. Existing relationships at 2+ of: Veeam, Cohesity, Rubrik, Databricks, Snowflake, Splunk, Datadog, Iconik, or a comparable ISV in the backup/data/MAM category. Experience running ISV partner programs end-to-end: integration certification, co-sell activation, joint GTM, and MDF governance. Technical fluency sufficient to guide integration architecture conversations — you understand S3-compatible APIs, object storage tiering, and how backup/recovery or data pipeline ISVs connect to cloud storage. Experience managing a portfolio of ISV relationships simultaneously — you can hold a QBR with Diversified and a technical integration review with Databricks in the same week. Salesforce proficiency for partner pipeline management and forecasting. Strongly Preferred Background in M&E technology or media workflow — understanding of MAM/DAM/PAM, post-production workflows, and the M&E integrator ecosystem (SI vs. VAR vs. ISV). Experience at or with a cloud storage, backup ISV, or data platform vendor (not hyperscaler). Familiarity with MDF governance, deal registration programs, and partner tiering structures. Understanding of AI/ML data pipeline use cases: training data storage, log archival, checkpoint management — specifically in the context of S3-compatible object storage. Existing relationships within the M&E integrator ecosystem (CHESA, Cinesys, Diversified, IMT, KCM, or equivalents) is a significant differentiator. This Role Is Not For You If You are a pure relationship manager who does not engage with technical integration depth — ISV partners will test your architecture knowledge immediately. You are not comfortable navigating complex partner ecosystems where the ISV, the integrator, and the end customer are three separate relationship tracks running simultaneously. You need a complete partner program to manage — parts of this are being built as you run it. title: Senior Director, Customer Business Development (CVS)
description: Back to jobs New Senior Director, Customer Business Development (CVS) Providence, Rhode Island, United States; Remote - US Apply At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day. Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Since its game-changing launch of the first opaque nail enamel in 1932 (and later, the first long-wear foundation), Revlon has provided consumers with high-quality product innovation, performance, and sophisticated glamour. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand. Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more. We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers. We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty. This role is a Remote Role: This is a fully remote position. Candidates be located in North East, United States, preferably by Rhode Island area with occasional travel up to 25% to customers or Revlon offices. Overview: The Sr. Director, Sales is responsible for developing, executing, and fostering a collaborative business partnership between Revlon brands and CVS with accountability for delivering volume, share, profitability, and customer category growth objectives. This role leads customer strategy across all Revlon brands, builds executive-level relationships, and translates company and customer priorities into long-range plans, annual joint business plans, and actionable commercial programs. The Sr. Director is expected to challenge the status quo, identify new go-to-market opportunities, influence across merchandising, marketing, supply chain, store operations, finance, and digital/omnichannel teams, and mobilize internal cross-functional partners to deliver business results with excellence. Responsibilities: 1. Lead long-range planning and annual Joint Business Planning with CVS, aligning Revlon and customer timelines to maximize execution, growth, share, and profitability. · Develop and maintain strategic relationships with customer leaders and buyers across merchandising, marketing, operations, supply chain, finance, and digital/omnichannel teams. · Identify and execute against key business drivers, including volume forecasting, category growth, POG strategy, secondary space, innovation, and promotional activation. · Lead long-lead customer planning to improve execution readiness and maximize in-market impact. · Effectively manage Market Development Funds and customer investment to support profitable growth. 2. Own annual gross sales and P&L delivery for CVS · In conjunction with the VP Sales, develop annual volume targets, customer P&Ls, and investment plans. · Provide business updates to senior Revlon leaders on customer progress, strategy, risks, opportunities, and outlook. · Track volume, consumption, share, profitability, and investment performance, and make appropriate business decisions to deliver agreed-to targets. 3. Develop, implement, and monitor weekly and annual consumption plans for integration into the overall account business plan. · Leverage customer, POS, syndicated, market, and competitive data to identify growth opportunities and risks. · Partner with Sales Insights, analysts, marketing, trade marketing, and finance to convert insights into customer-ready selling stories and action plans. · Track weekly/monthly performance versus plan and create close-the-gap plans where required. 4. Lead 4P execution and customer activity planning across product, price, promotion, and placement. · Communicate weekly/monthly results, risks, and gap-closing actions with internal teams and customer stakeholders. · Develop and implement business-building strategies to capitalize on opportunities and mitigate risks. · Integrate Revlon/Elizabeth Arden corporate strategy with the customer’s go-to-market strategy. 5. Partner with Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, Replenishment, and Logistics to maintain accurate shipment forecasts by segment and item. · Identify opportunities and risks for Demand Meetings and lead the demand planning inputs for Revlon and Almay Color Cosmetics. · Develop strategic plans to execute forecasts, address service challenges, and plan contingencies in partnership with replenishment and supply chain teams. 6. Lead, develop, and facilitate internal and external relationships in support of business objectives. · Internal partners include Sales Insights and Strategy, Marketing, Trade Marketing, Finance, Demand Planning, Logistics, Inventory Management, and Customer Service. · External partners include Category Management, Store Operations, Beauty Advisor/Consultant Leadership, Supply Chain/Replenishment, and relevant digital/retail media teams. 7. Manage Market Development Fund (MDF) investment to support customer growth and account profitability. · Determine investment needs based on business plans, ROI analysis, and customer growth priorities. · Analyze event ROI, gain authorization for incremental investment, track actual investment versus plan, and process account claims on a timely basis. · Manage the customer P&L to meet objectives set forth by CBD leadership. 8. Partner with Inventory Planning and Logistics to mitigate returns, markdown, and discontinued inventory risk. · Manage timely shutoff of discontinued SKUs based on customer inventory position. · Implement markdowns where there is a financial benefit. · Review new item and bonus pack inventory allocations to ensure the right level of inventory is deployed by store. 9. Lead and develop a team of Customer Business Managers, Associate Customer Business Managers, Analysts, and/or broker support partners. · Provide clear priorities, coaching, performance feedback, development planning, and succession support. · Build team capability in customer management, strategic selling, analytics, cross-functional influence, and executional excellence. 10. Provide channel leadership and support across planning, administration, partnerships, broker support, and collaboration within and across the broader Sales organization. 11. Perform other related duties as required. Supervision: Direct and/or indirect supervision of Customer Business Managers, Analyst, and broker/customer support resource Knowledge and Experience: Experience · 10+ years of direct selling, customer business management, commercial strategy, or related CPG experience required; cosmetics/beauty experience strongly preferred. · Drug channel experience required or strongly preferred; experience managing CVS, Rite Aid, Walgreens, and/or comparable national retail relationships preferred. · Demonstrated experience managing customer P&L, gross sales, trade/MDF investment, forecasting, and cross-functional business planning. · Prior people leadership experience required, including coaching, performance management, and team development. Strategic Thinking · Demonstrated ability to identify short- and long-range sustainable growth opportunities based on an in-depth understanding of company and customer strategies. · Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert POS, syndicated, financial, and marketplace data into compelling sales tools and customer business plans. · Demonstrated ability to take appropriate risks as part of a comprehensive long-range growth plan. Execution and Follow-Through · Ability to drive for results and deliver flawless execution across multiple priorities and stakeholders. · Ability and desire to operate as a hands-on commercial leader while maintaining strategic ownership. · Demonstrated success proactively planning, tracking, and delivering results from strategy through execution. Innovation and Creativity · Experience developing new business-building ideas based on a deep understanding of customer business drivers, shopper needs, category dynamics, and go-to-market strategies. Ability to identify white-space opportunities across innovation, merchandising, retail media, omnichannel, beauty services, and shopper engagement. Problem Solving · Ability to anticipate potential issues and develop proactive solutions to avoid business disruption. · Ability to evaluate multifaceted issues and align stakeholders around the best course of action. Communication and Influence · Executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior customer contacts and Revlon leadership. · Ability to influence cross-functionally and align internal teams around customer priorities, business risks, competitive activity, and execution needs. Systems and Tools · Advanced Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Adobe Acrobat skills required; Access or data visualization experience a plus. · Experience with customer portals, POS/syndicated data platforms, forecasting tools, and financial planning systems preferred. Minimum Requirements: · Minimum Education Required: Bachelor’s Degree required · Minimum Years of Experience Required: 10+ years of direct selling or customer business management experience required; cosmetics/beauty and drug channel experience preferred. #LI-CH2 #LI-Remote Revlon is unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this role; candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future visa support. The base pay range for this position is $170,000 - $210,000 / year; however base pay offered may vary depending on skills, experience, job-related knowledge, and geographic location. Certain positions may also be eligible for short-term incentives as part of total compensation. Employees (and their families) are eligible for medical, dental, and vision benefits. Employees are covered by the company-paid basic life insurance policy and company-paid short-term disability insurance (the benefit commences upon hire and allows for a portion of base salary for up to 26 weeks if you are disabled). Other benefits offered to employees include but are not limited to the following: long-term disability, supplemental life insurances, flexible spending accounts, critical illness insurance, group legal, identity theft protection, etc. Employees are also able to enroll in our 401k Retirement Savings Plan. Employees will also receive 4 weeks of vacation, pro-rated based on date of hire for the 1st year of employment and twelve paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Vacation will depend on role. description: Back to jobs New Sr Director, Pipeline Strategy & Analytics Boston, MA Apply About Starburst Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai. About the role: The Sr. Director, Pipeline Strategy & Analytics owns the metrics, systems, and strategy behind Starburst's pipeline, from generation through conversion, ensuring the company builds more pipeline, of higher quality, with clear visibility into what is working and what is not. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations, this role is the analytical authority on all pipeline metrics and marketing ROI, partnering closely with Marketing, Sales, and Finance to connect spend to sourced pipeline to closed revenue. The Sr. Director sets the measurement framework for pipeline throughput and quality, leads the marketing budget and ROI tracking process, and serves as the organization's thought leader on the technology and AI that increasingly drive modern demand generation and go-to-market operations. This is a highly technical, data-first leadership role that turns disparate go-to-market data into decisions leadership can act on, and it builds and leads a team responsible for pipeline analytics, reporting infrastructure, and the tooling and process that power the SDR and pipeline-generation motion. As a Sr. Director, Pipeline Strategy & Analytics at Starburst you will: Own all pipeline metrics end to end, from lead and MQL through opportunity creation, conversion, and closed revenue, and establish the single source of truth leadership uses to run the business. Define and drive the strategy to increase pipeline throughput and generate higher-quality pipeline, pinpointing the conversion bottlenecks and source-level quality signals that most affect revenue. Own marketing budget tracking and ROI measurement, connecting spend by program and channel to sourced pipeline and closed-won revenue, and guide reallocation toward the highest-returning investments. Build and maintain the reporting, dashboards, and attribution models that give Marketing, Sales, and Finance a shared, trusted view of pipeline health and marketing performance. Serve as the organization's thought leader on marketing and go-to-market technology and AI, evaluating and introducing tools that improve pipeline generation, efficiency, and measurement. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations on funnel definitions, stage conversion, and forecasting inputs so pipeline data is consistent and reliable across the go-to-market motion. Oversee the SDR technology stack and operating process, including sales-engagement and dialer tooling, lead routing and follow-up SLAs, and the workflows that drive SDR productivity and consistent, high-quality pipeline generation. Translate complex go-to-market data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior leadership, including board- and executive-level reporting on pipeline and marketing ROI. Own the accuracy of marketing and pipeline data across Salesforce, marketing automation, and adjacent RevOps systems, in partnership with Business Applications. Lead, mentor, and develop a team responsible for pipeline analytics, marketing operations, and reporting, building a high-judgment, data-first operating model that scales with the business. Some of the things we look for: 10+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, pipeline analytics, or go-to-market strategy, including experience owning pipeline metrics and marketing ROI for a B2B SaaS business. People management experience, with a track record of leading, mentoring, and developing a high-performing analytical team. Deeply technical and analytical, with hands-on fluency in SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar), Salesforce, and marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar). Strong command of pipeline and funnel mechanics, multi-touch attribution, and marketing ROI measurement, with the judgment to separate signal from noise. Demonstrated ability to increase pipeline throughput and quality through data-driven process, measurement, and cross-functional influence. Working knowledge of the modern marketing and go-to-market technology landscape, including applied AI, and a track record of evaluating and adopting tools that improve efficiency and measurement. Hands-on experience owning SDR and sales-engagement tooling and process (Outreach, Salesloft, or similar), lead routing, and the metrics that drive SDR productivity and pipeline generation. Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Operations. Preferred: experience with consumption-based business models, data modeling or engineering, and building analytics or reporting infrastructure from the ground up. Ability to Travel: This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs. Where could this role be based? This role is based in our Boston office or open to US-based remote candidates. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our Ideal Candidate Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives. The Role Hone is looking for a Quality Engineer II to join our Engineering team. This is an early-career role for someone who has a year or two of testing under their belt and is ready to own the quality of their own features. You will report to the Director of QA and work alongside senior quality and software engineers who will help you keep growing. At Hone, there is one Quality Engineer track. You will both test and automate, and you will use AI to do both faster. You will handle small features and bugs with little supervision, deliver scoped work on time, and build the judgment that carries you toward Quality Engineer III and beyond. This is not a manual-only or a script-running role - it is a real engineering career on a clear path. Primary Responsibilities Write and maintain test cases for your own features with little guidance, covering the happy path and the obvious edge cases, and raise risks when you spot them Own testing for the small features and bugs assigned to you, delivering scoped work on time without much hand-holding Write reliable automated tests for your features on your own (end-to-end tests in Playwright and API-level tests) following the team’s conventions Chase down flaky tests and keep your part of the suite stable, asking for help when you need it Run exploratory checks and write clear, reproducible bug reports that anyone on the team can act on Work with AI tools day to day to draft cases, automation, and selectors - and spot and fix output that is wrong or unsafe, following the team’s AI conventions Apply patient-data guardrails consistently: keep test data synthetic and never put real patient data in test cases, bug reports, or any other test artifact Give short, useful code and test reviews, talk through the direction of your own work, and give teammates helpful feedback Qualifications Roughly 1-2 years of experience in software quality, testing, or test automation Working programming or scripting ability in at least one language (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or C#) Comfortable writing automated tests and maintaining them, ideally with Playwright or comparable UI and API testing frameworks Comfortable with version control (Git), running a test suite, and basic debugging on your own Works with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) as part of a daily workflow, and reviews their output rather than trusting it blindly Dependable communication: clear bug reports, useful reviews, and the habit of talking through your own work A track record of finishing scoped work on time with little supervision A genuine interest in healthcare and in protecting the patients who rely on our platform We do not expect you to meet every line above. description: Back to jobs New ServiceNow Business Analyst United States Apply LightFeather is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Business Analyst to lead the requirements gathering and process design for our federal agency clients. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between federal business stakeholders and our technical development teams. You will be responsible for translating complex mission requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions, ensuring compliance with federal standards, and maintaining the highest quality of data in our backlog.. This is a Full Time, Remote Position. Location: Fully Remote (EST hours) Job Type: Full-time Salary: $110,000–$130,000 annually, based on experience Clearance Requirement: U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to federal contract requirements and the need to obtain and maintain a Secret-level security clearance Responsibilities Lead client workshops and focus groups to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements, ensuring alignment with agency mission goals. Translate high-level business needs into comprehensive user stories, acceptance criteria (AC), and functional specifications within Agile/Scrum frameworks. Conduct gap analysis to identify the delta between current legacy processes and ServiceNow "Out of the Box" (OOTB) functionality. Collaborate directly with the Agile Coach to design, document, and distribute new Agile processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) that support all ServiceNow delivery teams. Ensure these processes drive consistency, efficiency, and alignment across the broader program. Review all user stories and requirements for accuracy, completeness, and ambiguity. Ensure every story meets the team's "Definition of Ready" before it is approved for sprint planning. Provide guidance and mentorship to junior developers and junior analysts. Help them understand business context, federal domain constraints, and ServiceNow best practices to foster their professional growth. Conduct peer reviews of functional designs and test scripts to maintain high standards of quality control across the delivery team. Develop detailed process maps, workflows, and data models to visualize end-to-end service delivery. Advise government stakeholders on ServiceNow best practices, steering them away from excessive customization that creates technical debt. Collaborate with System Architects to ensure functional designs are technically feasible. Ensure all solution designs adhere to federal IT standards, including Section 508 compliance (accessibility) and FISMA/NIST security controls. Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans, creating test scripts and coordinating testing sessions with government personnel. Create federal-grade deliverables, including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), User Guides, and Training Decks. Required Qualifications and Skills: U.S. Citizenship Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret Level security clearance. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with at least 3 years dedicated to the ServiceNow platform. Proven experience working in the federal contracting space (DoD, DHS, or Civilian agencies). Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. Deep knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM and at least one other major workflow (e.g., ITOM, HRSD, SPM, ITAM, Custom Applications). Strong experience with Jira, ServiceNow Agile, or Azure DevOps for backlog management. Proficiency in Visio, LucidChart, or similar tools for process mapping. description: Back to jobs New Senior Quantitative Analyst Remote - Europe Apply About Schumacher Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the$150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life.We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers “celebrate the feeling of home”. F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally. Our competitive advantage in the industry is our people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company core values which are as follows: Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit Take Ownership & Accountability Be Solutions-Oriented Demonstrate Courage Practice Adaptability Embrace Collaboration We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role is a part of Data Insights & AI team Role Overview We're looking for a hands-on, Senior Quantitative Analyst, Product Portfolio (Statistical Modeling) to own analytics and reporting in support of our Portfolio Development team, with a specific focus on SKU productivity & capital allocation across a portfolio of 20,000+ SKUs and growing. This role will report directly to the Sr. Director of AI & Data Insights, but is expected to work directly with the CEO & Chief of Staff on a day-to-day basis. This is not a role for someone who takes data at face value. You'll need to distinguish real signal from noise (e.g., a SKU selling poorly because it's out of stock, not because demand is weak), and when you find data that's wrong or inconsistent, you'll have the access and judgment to go into Snowflake and fix it — not just flag it and wait. What You’ll Do Work hands-on with CEO & Product Strategy stakeholders to understand key strategic questions, and then build analysis and reporting to address them directly Use statistical methods (e.g. conjoint analysis, multivariate regression) to identify which product attributes and characteristics (e.g., color, pattern, material, price point, availability) drive productivity, and translate that into data-driven guidance on where the portfolio should expand, contract or shift Cut through data noise at scale: systematically identify and control for confounders like stock-outs, new/discontinued SKUs, and seasonality so reported trends reflect real pattern performance Identify data inconsistencies at the source (e.g., ERP, web, product master data) and directly and systematically correct records in Snowflake and work with upstream platform owners to improve the accuracy of source data and downstream analytics Present findings clearly and independently to executive audiences, adapting the message for technical or non-technical stakeholders Recommend and maintain recurring analytics & reporting to provide accurate and timely snapshot of SKU productivity Use AI across your own workflow to explore data faster, automate repetitive reporting, catch errors, and multiply output given the scale and growth of the SKU portfolio What we're looking for 2-5 years in data science, analytics, statistics in similar SKU-driven businesses Solid grounding in statistics or operations research (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis, optimization). Able to move beyond descriptive reporting to model relationships between variables and quantify drivers, not just flag correlations Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on Snowflake experience including writing back to correct or clean production data (not just read-only querying) A track record of presenting findings and challenging assumptions directly with senior stakeholders and executives Independent executor — sets analysis priorities against business goals without waiting for direction, and ships accurate, high-impact work in a timely manner Curiosity — asks why the numbers look the way they do and keeps digging until the answer holds up, rather than reporting the first number that looks plausible Thinks in terms of SKU-level economics: sell-through, margin, inventory position, lifecycle stage — and knows how to separate a true productivity problem from a data artifact Treats data quality as part of the job, digging into root causes and correcting them directly rather than working around bad data Hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a business context for task automation - automating repetitive analysis to spend more time on judgment calls Strong English communication skills and a high ownership mindset Nice to Have Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools alongside Snowflake Exposure to margin, pricing, or demand forecasting data Experience in retail, e-commerce, or luxury/home furnishings goods What we offer Competitive salary and benefits, based on experience Fully remote work within Europe, with optional time in our NYC office (1–2 weeks per year) Direct visibility with the CEO, with real influence on Product Strategy and Merchandising decisions Collaborative, inclusive, and low-ego working environment We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be.
